documents.text: ### Introduction The first parameter of the handler function is `Request`. Request is a core Fastify object containing the following fields: - `query` - The parsed querystring. - `body` - The request payload. - `params` - The params matching the URL. - [`headers`](#headers) - The headers getter and setter. - `raw` - The incoming HTTP request from Node core. - `server` - The Fastify server instance. - `id` - The request ID. - `log` - The logger instance of the incoming request. - `ip` - The IP address of the incoming request. - `ips` - An array of IP addresses from `X-Forwarded-For`. - `host` - The host of the incoming request. - `hostname` - The hostname parsed from `request.host`. - `port` - The port parsed from `request.host`. - `protocol` - The protocol of the incoming request (`https` or `http`). - `method` - The method of the incoming request. - `url` - The URL of the incoming request. - `originalUrl` - The original URL of the incoming request. - `mediaType` - The media type extracted from `Content-Type` header. - `is404` - `true` if request is being handled by 404 handler, `false` otherwise. - `socket` - The underlying connection of the incoming request. - `signal` - An `AbortSignal` that aborts on handler timeout or client disconnect. - `routeOptions` - The route [`option`](./Routes.md#routes-options) object. - `validationError` - The validation error, when `attachValidation` is set. - `getDecorator(name)` - Returns the value of a request decorator. - `setDecorator(name, value)` - Sets the value of a request decorator. - [.getValidationFunction(schema | httpPart)](#getvalidationfunction) - Returns a validation function for the specified schema or HTTP part, if set or cached. - [.compileValidationSchema(schema, [httpPart])](#compilevalidationschema) - Compiles the specified schema and returns a validation function using the default (or customized) `ValidationCompiler`. The optional `httpPart` is forwarded to the `ValidationCompiler` if provided, defaults to `null`. - [.validateInput(data, schema | httpPart, [httpPart])](#validate) - Validates the input using the specified schema or HTTP part and returns `true` if the input is valid, `false` otherwise. If `httpPart` is provided, the function uses the validator for that HTTP part. Defaults to `null`.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
